(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (if (for/or ((dr (list -1 0 1)))
                                (for/or ((dc (list -1 0 1)))
                                        (let ((nr (+ r dr))
                                              (nc (+ c dc)))
                                          (and
                                            (>= nr 0)
                                            (< nr h)
                                            (>= nc 0)
                                            (< nc w)
                                            (= 5 (at g nr nc))))))
                        1
                        0)))))

(rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((expanded ((lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (cellmap g (r c v) (if (for/or ((dr (list -1 0 1))) (for/or ((dc (list -1 0 1))) (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc))) (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w) (= 5 (at g nr nc)))))) 1 0)))) g)) (groups (objects expanded 0)))
      (if (null? groups) expanded
        (let* ((score (lambda (obj) (obj-size obj)))
               (target (apply max (map score groups)))
               (winners (filter (lambda (obj) (= (score obj) target)) groups)))
          (for/fold ((out (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c) 0))))
                    ((obj (in-list winners)))
            (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 1)))))))
